metadata.dataset_note: The source file includes a 2026 cohort before kickoff. Treat 2026 as a dataset row, not completed tournament history.
metadata.comparison_window_note: Country history baselines prefer 1986 to 1996, then fall back to the latest earlier tournament.

story_manifest.headline: World Cup players have grown taller
story_manifest.summary: Average listed height rises from 173.90 cm in 1930 to 182.76 cm in 2026.

story_manifest.headline: World Cup squads are older now
story_manifest.summary: Average age rises from 24.83 years in 1930 to 27.94 in 2026.

story_manifest.headline: Bosnia and Herzegovina is the tallest 2026 squad in the file
Panama is the oldest 2026 squad in the file
Group B is the tallest group on average
story_manifest.summary: Group B averages 185.69 cm, while Group K is oldest at 28.93 years.

story_manifest.headline: UEFA enters 2026 with the tallest confederation profile
story_manifest.summary: UEFA teams average 185.57 cm, ahead of CONMEBOL at 180.24 cm and the rest of the field.

story_manifest.headline: The oldest groups are not always the tallest ones
story_manifest.summary: Group K leads on age at 28.93 years, while Group B leads on height.

story_manifest.headline: Some 2026 teams changed physically far more than others
story_manifest.summary: The country comparison module shows which squads are much taller or older than their nearest 1994 or 1986 benchmark, and which ones barely moved.
